changelog: Shotgun metagenome pipeline (beta): new menu entry, Illumina pairs or Oxford Nanopore reads; fastp / chopper QC, optional host removal with Hostile (human, mouse or a genome FASTA), Kraken 2 + Bracken species abundance, tables in the amplicon layout so composition, diversity, Controls and MaAsLin 3 work, and its own report. Separate script, conda env (ngamp-meta, setup_shotgun.sh) and index folder; nothing the amplicon or WGS pipelines use was changed in behaviour. Licence bit 9 'Shotgun' (dev machines: open). tests/run_shotgun_mock.sh checks it end to end. Experimental: build_16s_typestrain_db.py makes a 16S reference from every 16S copy of the type-strain genomes, for Emu and DADA2; evaluated against Emu default and SILVA 138.2 it was not better (see the script header), so the existing databases stay the default. ONT WGS: the app showed '0 genomes' for type strains downloaded by v2.18.1. Backend restart required (license.py changed: restart right after the update).

previous.changelog: Type-strain genomes in the app: Settings shows the offline NCBI type-strain set (genomes, size, age) and downloads or updates it with one button, with live progress; the download runs in its own session and survives a backend restart. A reminder (dot on Settings, banner on the home screen, 'remind me in 2 weeks') appears 3 months after the last full update and turns red at 6. The ONT WGS form shows whether type strains are available offline. Backend restart required.
